item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: Laifọwọyi mu omi ati awọn ohun mimu miiran lati apoeyin lati pa ongbẹ
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Gba awọn ohun mimu ti a ṣe akojọ (lo igo omi tabi garawa fun omi ojò)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: Dina awọn ohun mimu ti a ṣe akojọ (lo igo omi tabi garawa fun omi ojò)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: Mu nigbakugba ti ọti ongbẹ ko kun
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: Mu nigba ti o kere ju idaji ti mimu-pada sipo ongbẹ mimu le ṣee lo
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: Mu nikan nigbati gbogbo imupadabọ ongbẹ ongbẹ ohun mimu le ṣee lo
